skill.name: fix-review
skill.description: Review security fix commits to confirm they resolve audit findings without adding regressions.
skill.summary: Checks whether remediation commits fully address audit findings and avoid new security issues.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code, scripts, or tool automation. The two static network findings are source repository links in documentation, not network access behavior.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is front matter metadata pointing to the upstream source repository. It does not instruct the agent to make a network request or send data externally.
The URL appears in a Resources section as a documentation link. It is not executable code and does not create network behavior by itself.

content.value_statement: Security fixes can miss root causes or introduce regressions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured fix validation.
actual_capabilities: Compares fix commits against original audit findings.
Checks whether the root cause was addressed.
Reviews code changes for regressions and new vulnerabilities.
Prompts validation of tests for the fixed scenario.
Encourages searching for similar vulnerable patterns elsewhere.
limitations: It provides review guidance, not automated static analysis.
It depends on access to the original finding and fix diff.
It cannot prove a vulnerability is fixed without sufficient context.
It does not execute tests unless the host assistant has tool access.

use_cases.title: Validate Remediation Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Review a pull request that claims to resolve a security audit finding.

use_cases.title: Check Regression Risk
use_cases.description: Assess whether a fix changes nearby behavior or creates a new weakness.

use_cases.title: Confirm Audit Closure
use_cases.description: Prepare evidence that a finding was fixed before closing an audit item.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single remediation commit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this fix commit against the original audit finding. Explain whether the change resolves the issue and list any remaining concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Check Root Cause
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the original vulnerability, affected data flow, and patch. Decide whether the root cause is fixed or only the symptom changed.

prompt_templates.title: Assess New Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for regressions and side effects.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this remediation diff for new bugs, authorization gaps, input validation mistakes, and missing test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Similar Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across related code paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: After reviewing the fix, search the surrounding code for similar vulnerable patterns. Report whether additional remediation is needed.

output_examples.input: A pull request claims to fix an authorization bypass in an API endpoint.
output_examples.output: The review states whether the authorization check covers all affected paths, then lists test gaps and residual risk.

output_examples.input: A commit sanitizes user input after a stored cross-site scripting finding.
output_examples.output: The review explains whether output encoding and stored data handling are complete, then identifies any similar sinks nearby.

output_examples.input: A patch changes error handling after a secret disclosure finding.
output_examples.output: The review confirms whether sensitive data is removed from responses and logs, then notes regression tests to add.

best_practices: Provide the original finding, fix diff, and relevant tests together.
Ask for root cause validation before accepting symptom-level changes.
Review nearby code paths for the same vulnerable pattern.
anti_patterns: Reviewing a patch without the original audit finding.
Accepting a fix only because a test was added.
Ignoring behavior changes outside the vulnerable function.

faq.question: Does this skill run security scanners?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured review guidance for evaluating fix commits and remediation evidence.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the original finding, the fix diff, relevant files, and any tests that support the fix.

faq.question: Can it confirm a finding is closed?
faq.answer: It can help assess closure, but final acceptance depends on reviewer judgment and available evidence.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for guided remediation review.

faq.question: Can it find similar vulnerable code?
faq.answer: Yes, it prompts the assistant to check nearby code for related patterns when context is available.

faq.question: Is this only for security teams?
faq.answer: No. Developers and engineering leads can use it to review security fixes before merge or closure.
